ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a square EFGH, with the left side EH and the right side FG being vertical sides. Rectangle ABCD is a horizontal long strip, the left side AD lies on the left side EH of the square, and the rectangle extends rightward beyond the square. The overlapping part of the rectangle and the square is the shaded rectangle, whose height is AD and whose width equals the side length of the square. Reasoning: Let the side length of the square be s, the rectangle height AD be h, and the rectangle length AB be L. The overlapping area is sh. The problem statement gives that the overlapping area is 50% of the rectangle area, so sh = 0.5(Lh), giving L = 2s. Also the overlapping area is 20% of the square area, so sh = 0.2s^2, giving h = s/5. Therefore AB/AD = L/h = 2s/(s/5) = 10.

method.method_draft: Direct variable setup. First read the diagram: square EFGH has left side EH and right side FG vertical; rectangle ABCD is a horizontal strip whose left side AD lies on the square's left edge and whose top/bottom edges pass across the square, so the overlap is a rectangle of height AD and width equal to the square side. Let the square side be s, the rectangle height be h=AD, and the rectangle length be L=AB. From the text, the overlap area is 50% of the rectangle area and 20% of the square area. Thus sh=0.5(Lh) and sh=0.2s^2. The first gives L=2s; the second gives h=s/5. Therefore AB/AD=L/h=2s/(s/5)=10.

method.method_draft: Normalize and compare pieces. Read the diagram first: the gray shared region is a horizontal strip running all the way from the square's left side to its right side, so its width is exactly one square side; the rectangle continues to the right beyond the square. Set the square's area to 100 units, so its side is 10 units. The text says the square shares 20% of its area with the rectangle, so the overlap area is 20. Since the overlap width is 10, AD, the strip height, is 20/10=2. The text also says this overlap is 50% of the rectangle's area, so the whole rectangle area is 40. With height AD=2, AB=40/2=20. Hence AB/AD=20/2=10.

推理：按方法归一化，设正方形 EFGH 的面积为 100，则正方形边长为 10。题目说正方形与矩形的重叠面积是正方形面积的 20%，所以重叠面积为 20。由于重叠区域宽度等于正方形边长 10，高度就是 AD，因此 AD = 20 / 10 = 2。题目还说这个重叠面积是矩形 ABCD 面积的 50%，所以矩形面积为 20 / 0.5 = 40。矩形面积 = AB × AD，因此 AB = 40 / 2 = 20。于是 AB / AD = 20 / 2 = 10。
